compression.amplitude_calibrated: d=q_minus-q_plus; m_d=(d.b)/(d.d). Adding lambda*d shifts m_d by exactly lambda.
compression.amplitude_free_shape_only: rho=(q_plus.q_minus)/(q_plus.q_plus); r=q_minus-rho*q_plus; m_r=(r.b)/(r.r). After free plus-template amplitude refit, adding lambda*q_minus shifts m_r by exactly lambda.
compression.why: Both are preregisterable one-dimensional theory-defined compressions, avoiding any 12D inverse covariance with only nine mocks.

interpretation.E49_rrec0p8_note: Dividing thresholds by the E49 sign-retention factor is only an optimistic signal-only degradation. A real reconstructed velocity field can also change the estimator background and must eventually be tested directly.
interpretation.fingerprint_window_survival: The post-window F+/F- angle remains close to the E19 source angle in both caps; the relative amplitude separation also stays near 43.5%.
interpretation.next: Do not unblind. Next test should scale the exact same marked estimator to full eligible mock galaxies and denser frozen randoms to determine how much of the E51/E52 background is subsampling shot noise.
interpretation.shape_only: The shape-only residual is much smaller than the amplitude difference and therefore has multi-unit background thresholds; this confirms the E50 warning that shape-only inference is much harder.
interpretation.small_sample_background: With only the A02 600D/1200R subsamples, the amplitude-calibrated F-state difference coordinate has descriptive 83% thresholds from ~0.33-0.50 in NGC and ~0.09-0.28 in SGC depending on the fixed synthetic tag field.
